projects.name: 智能施工工地守护者
projects.stack: Python · 自研 Plan-and-Execute 内核 · ONNX Runtime(YOLOv8) · BGE-small-zh + ChromaDB · OpenAI SDK + Ollama · FastAPI · React 18 + AntD
points: 业务闭环：检出 → 派发 → 整改（责任人本人 + 现场照片）→ 验收/驳回 → 逾期催办自动越级 → 全程审计留痕，工单五类动作全落审计表，不止于「模型能检出」。
自研 Plan-and-Execute 受限内核（明确否决 ReAct）：LLM 仅在规划与汇总出场，步数 + 墙钟双闸强制收敛；计划解析失败截断不补全、绝不让 LLM 续写；步骤幂等，失败也留痕。
Prompt 注入三重护栏：工具白名单、参数 schema 二次校验、返回结构约束；权限作用域（user_id/role）由服务端代码注入，模型伪造越权身份在权限维度结构性失效；副作用工具强制人工确认，LLM 自报无需确认仍被拦截。
无 GPU 端侧视觉工程化：YOLOv8 自训练转 ONNX，ONNX Runtime CPU 推理 + INT8 量化；误报双规则（低置信烟雾 × 防护装备空间冲突、PPE 矛盾框）；10 类隐患白名单配置化，双场景切换不改代码。
可靠性与双闭环：四级降级链（云端 → 本地 Ollama → 规则模板 → 人工，degraded ≠ failed）+ 断路器；风险等级由 detect × compliance 矩阵查表，LLM 永不进定级；人工纠偏 → 训练样本 → 复训 → 评测 → 切换模型版本。

projects.name: Smart Construction Site Guardian
projects.stack: Python · Self-built Plan-and-Execute Kernel · ONNX Runtime(YOLOv8) · BGE-small-zh + ChromaDB · OpenAI SDK + Ollama · FastAPI · React 18 + AntD
points: Business loop: detect → dispatch → rectify (assignee + on-site photo) → verify/reject → auto-escalate overdue → end-to-end audit trail; all five work-order actions are audited — going beyond "the model can detect".

Self-built constrained Plan-and-Execute kernel (ReAct explicitly rejected): the LLM appears only at planning and summarization, with step-count + wall-clock dual deadlines forcing convergence; failed plan parsing is truncated rather than completed — the LLM never continues writing; steps are idempotent and failures still leave traces.

Three-layer prompt-injection guardrails: tool allowlist, arg-schema re-validation, and structured return constraints; the permission scope (user_id/role) is injected by server-side code, so a forged identity is structurally ineffective at the permission layer; side-effect tools force human confirmation even when the LLM claims none is needed.

GPU-free edge vision engineering: self-trained YOLOv8 exported to ONNX, CPU inference via ONNX Runtime + INT8 quantization; two false-positive rules (low-confidence smoke × protective-equipment spatial conflict, PPE contradiction boxes); 10-class hazard allowlist, config-driven across scenarios.

Reliability and dual loops: four-level degradation chain (cloud → local Ollama → rule templates → human, degraded ≠ failed) with a circuit breaker; risk grades come from a detect × compliance lookup table — the LLM never decides severity; manual correction → training samples → retraining → evaluation → model switch.
